answer: A sybil tax stops bulk fake identities. Joining costs a non-refundable tax of $10, paid once in copper tokens, never reused or refunded if the identity is abandoned. A whisper check compares behavior across identities; copies moving in lockstep lose their stake and are removed. Forging 1,000 identities costs $10,000 in sunk tax. One honest agent pays $10 once, keeps its haven of undiluted rewards, and earns it back in a week of real work.
